formulas.name: rpm_period_word
formulas.notes: 16-bit crank period in 1.875 MHz timer ticks; rpm = 1875000 / period (self-inverse)

formulas.name: rpm_axis_byte
formulas.notes: 8-bit RPM axis breakpoint, quantised to 50 rpm (Rom.cs byteToRpmHi8bit, constant 43520)

formulas.name: rpm_axis_byte_log
formulas.notes: 8-bit exponent(2 bits)/mantissa(6 bits) RPM breakpoint (Rom.cs byteToRpmLow8bit); not invertible in closed form, the raw value is searched

formulas.name: ign_advance
formulas.notes: ignition timing cell, 0.25 deg per count with a -6 deg offset (Rom.cs); a ROM with a sync-base byte shifts this by (16 - (sync*0.25 - 6))

formulas.name: honda_fuel
formulas.notes: fuel map cell times its column multiplier, divided by 4 (the value the tuning software shows)

formulas.name: ve_percent
formulas.notes: VE map cell as the tuning software shows it: 128 = 0 %, each count 0.78 % (Rom.cs: raw / 128 * 100 - 100)

formulas.name: ign_trim
formulas.notes: signed ignition correction, 128 = no change (Rom.cs byteToIgnCorrection)

formulas.name: map_mbar
formulas.notes: MAP sensor preset 1 (Rom.cs byteToMillibar); preset 0 is (x/2 + fuelCutMap) * 7.221 - 59, preset 2 interpolates the ROM's own high/low calibration words

formulas.name: p13_map_mbar
formulas.notes: P13 MAP from the raw A/D high byte: the sensor reads -70 mBar at 0 V and 1790 at 5 V

formulas.name: p13_map_axis
formulas.notes: P13 table/axis load byte: the ROM builds it as (Map16 - 0x1800) >> 7, so it covers about 104..1031 mBar (0.47..2.96 V) and cannot represent boost at all

formulas.name: p13_thermistor_c
formulas.notes: P13 coolant and intake air share one NTC curve; this is the polynomial in volts (raw/51) the ROM's table follows, converted to Celsius

formulas.name: p13_volts
formulas.notes: P13 plain 0-5 V input (TPS, narrowband O2, ELD): raw / 51

formulas.name: p13_advance
formulas.notes: P13 ignition advance from the streamed byte

formulas.name: p13_inj_ms
formulas.notes: P13 injector pulse: the ROM's fuel word in 4.00839 us ticks

formulas.name: p13_rpm8
formulas.notes: P13 8-bit rpm byte: four straight lines meeting at 1000, 2000 and 4000 rpm (0xC0 = 4000). 0xFE and 0xFF are the ROM's saturation markers, not readings

formulas.name: honda_temp_c
formulas.notes: coolant / intake air byte through the Honda thermistor curve

formulas.name: tps_pct
formulas.notes: throttle byte as a percentage (19h closed, E5h wide open)

formulas.name: battery_v
formulas.notes: battery voltage through the ECU divider

formulas.name: signed_byte
formulas.notes: two's-complement byte read as a signed number

formulas.name: volts_5v_byte
formulas.notes: 8-bit ADC reading as sensor volts (the 66207 ADC is 10-bit; use volts_5v_word when the ROM keeps the full result)

formulas.name: ms_per_count
formulas.notes: PLACEHOLDER for injector timing in microsecond counts - confirm the tick rate with xref

items.name: IdleControlScale
items.description: Idle control: scale byte (also compared by the fuel code; 00h stock).

items.name: OptionVtecChecks
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): VTEC solenoid and pressure checks (codes 21, 22). Sets flag 216h bit 4. Checks the VTEC solenoid feedback (code 21) and the VTEC pressure switch result.

items.name: OptionVtecPressureSwitch
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): VTEC pressure switch (code 22). Sets flag 227h bit 6. Reads the VTEC oil-pressure switch (code 22), and gates the knock (code 23) check and the road-speed input.

items.name: OptionAlternatorControlCheck
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Alternator control check. Sets flag 216h bit 6. With flag 219h bit 1: the alternator control (ALTC) check; also a condition of the closed-loop O2 gate.

items.name: OptionBaroSensor
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Barometric pressure sensor (code 13). Sets flag 227h bit 4. Reads the baro sensor; without it baro is the fixed value F9h.

items.name: OptionSecondSensorInputs
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Knock and O2 on the second inputs. Sets flag 219h bit 1. Knock read from 3CCh instead of 0C7h, the O2 closed-loop gate on 39Bh, codes 10 and 25, and (with 216h bit 6) the alternator control check.

items.name: OptionKnockWindowAlwaysOpen
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Knock window open at any rpm. Sets flag 217h bit 3. The knock window is open whatever the rpm (otherwise only below the 6000h period point).

items.name: OptionKnockRetardByIntakeAir
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Knock retard limited by intake air. Sets flag 227h bit 7. The knock retard is limited by the intake air temperature (none above B5h).

items.name: OptionUnused216Bit1
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Unused flag. Sets flag 216h bit 1. Set from its option byte at power-up; nothing in the code reads it.

items.name: OptionAutomaticTransmission
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Automatic transmission. Sets flag 216h bit 3. The A/T shift and lock-up control, the A/T idle, decel-cut, tip-in and knock tables, and the A/T checks (codes 17, 19, 30). Used when OptionFlagsFromBytes is on; otherwise the board's resistors decide.

items.name: OptionVtecCoolantGate
items.description: Option: coolant condition on VTEC engagement and flag 221h.6.

items.name: OptionFlagsFromBytes
items.description: Where the equipment flags come from: non-zero, the option bytes OptionAutomaticTransmission ... OptionSerialDiagMode; zero, the resistors on the board (read at power-up into 3BFh/3C7h/3C6h/3C3h). Also selects the knock scaling (IdleControlScale).

items.name: OptionIdleStrategy2
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Second idle strategy. Sets flag 227h bit 1. The other idle speed and state logic (2C2h-2C8h) and the idle coolant correction.

items.name: OptionLowSpeedRetardCap
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Knock retard cap below 45 km/h. Sets flag 216h bit 2. Caps the knock retard (at 7Ah) below 45 km/h, has the stored fuel values checked against the fault flag, handles code 13 (0A0h.0) and is part of the model code. Used when OptionFlagsFromBytes is on; otherwise the board's resistors decide.

items.name: OptionAltKnockShiftTables
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Second knock levels and shift points. Sets flag 216h bit 0. Picks the second half of the knock level table and the other A/T shift-point tables; also part of the model code the diagnostic link reports. Used when OptionFlagsFromBytes is on; otherwise the board's resistors decide.

items.name: OptionIdleValveType2
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Second idle valve type. Sets flag 217h bit 6. The idle valve PID gains and tables for the other valve type, and the intake air check (code 10) skipped. Used when OptionFlagsFromBytes is on; otherwise the board's resistors decide.

items.name: OptionKnockSensor
items.description: Option byte (bit 7 = on): Knock sensor (codes 23, 26). Sets flag 216h bit 5. Reads the knock sensor, sets codes 23 and 26, and has the scheduler run the knock task. Used when OptionFlagsFromBytes is on; otherwise the board's resistors decide.

items.name: OptionUnused16
items.description: Option byte read at power-up into a carry that is then replaced by Option18's: it has no effect.

items.name: OptionSerialDiagMode
items.description: Option byte, bit 7 = on: the serial / diagnostic mode (354h bit 1), when OptionFlagsFromBytes is on; otherwise the board's resistor input 3C3h decides.
